milestone.title: Fuzzy search across plan artifacts (mp search)

intent.outcome: Users and agents can fuzzy-search all plan artifacts (milestones, steps, ideas, tracks, decisions) with a single mp search command, getting ranked results without external tools or manual parsing.

problem.description: Finding a milestone, step, idea, or track item by name/topic currently requires either: (1) parsing mp list --format json output with external tools (jq, python), (2) grepping TOML files directly (plan-zone violation), or (3) remembering exact IDs. There's no single quick-search command. The fuzzy-matcher crate provides lightweight, zero-dependency fuzzy matching that works on in-memory strings — ideal for searching plan artifacts already loaded into Rust structs. This directly benefits humans (quick lookup) and agents (structured JSON results with relevance scores, fewer roundtrips).

in_scope: mp search <query> command that fuzzy-matches against all plan artifacts
--type milestone|step|idea|track|decision flag to narrow search scope
--format json output with relevance scores, artifact type, ID, title/summary, and matched field
--format human output as a ranked table with colored scores
Matches against: milestone title, intent.outcome, problem.description, step action, AC description, idea title/body, track item title/problem, decision summary
DIY fuzzy scorer (substring match weighted by position/density/coverage) — no new crate, per the dependency-diet direction (M21/M22)
out_of_scope: Full-text search over plan files on disk (we search already-loaded data)
Frecency or history tracking (vanilla fuzzy scoring only)
TUI/search UI (human format uses terminal table)
Indexing or persistent state (search is always live against current data)
Adding the fuzzy-matcher crate (DIY scorer instead)
A --fields JSON-projection option for mp show/list (separate idea)

acceptance_criteria.description: mp search 'install' returns M51 Install & distribution architecture and M56 Unified harness registry, ranked by relevance
mp search 'install' --type milestone returns only milestones, mp search --type step returns only steps
mp search 'zzz-nonexistent' returns empty results (not an error)

work_packages.name: Core search engine
work_packages.goal: Implement the fuzzy search engine: add fuzzy-matcher dep, build SearchResult struct, implement search across milestone/step/idea/track/decision data

work_packages.name: CLI + tests
work_packages.goal: Wire up mp search CLI command, human/JSON output formatting, and integration tests

steps.action: Create crates/mp/src/search.rs with a SearchResult struct and a DIY fuzzy score function (no external crate — substring match weighted by position, density, and coverage). Respects the dependency-diet direction (M21/M22). No new entry in Cargo.toml.
steps.done_when: fuzzy-matcher in Cargo.toml; crates/mp/src/search.rs exists with SearchResult struct and search function signature

steps.action: Implement the search engine logic in crates/mp/src/search.rs: iterate milestones with their steps and ACs, ideas, track items, and decisions; run the DIY scorer on each text field; collect and deduplicate results sorted by score descending.
steps.done_when: Search impl iterates all artifact types, runs fuzzy_match on text fields, deduplicates and sorts by score descending

steps.action: Add 'mp search <query>' CLI command with --type milestone|step|idea|track|decision, --limit N (default 20), and --format json/human flags. JSON output includes relevance scores, artifact type, ID, title, matched field. Human output prints a ranked table.
steps.done_when: mp search <query> works with --type, --limit, --format json/human; CLI tests pass

steps.action: Write integration tests for mp search: fuzzy match returns ranked results, --type filter scopes correctly, empty query returns no results, results include scores and matched fields. Create crates/mp/tests/fuzzy_search.rs.
steps.done_when: fuzzy_search.rs tests pass: fuzzy match returns ranked results, --type filters work, empty query returns empty

steps.action: Document mp search in docs/concepts/06 Reference/MP-COMMANDS.md and verify the command appears in mp --help. Document --type, --limit, --format json/human flags with examples.
steps.done_when: mp search documented and visible in mp --help
